key_findings.detail: The CircleCI customer anomaly detection date is 2022-12-29, NOT 2022-12-25. The draft postmortem contained a transcription error. The corrected date is confirmed by the official CircleCI post-mortem at https://circleci.com/blog/jan-4-2023-incident-report/

key_findings.finding: Vendor advisory v1 scope limitation incorrect
key_findings.detail: The initial CircleCI vendor advisory claimed impact was 'limited to CircleCI internal systems only'. This is incorrect — the advisory v2 corrects this to include potential customer secrets exposure.

AWS STS GetSessionToken/GetFederationToken max lifetime = 36 hours. Deny-all IAM policy with DateLessThan on aws:TokenIssueTime is the correct containment. Reference: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/what-to-do-if-you-inadvertently-expose-an-aws-access-key/

circleci_reference_corrected.note: customer_detection_date 2022-12-29 is authoritative. The draft date 2022-12-25 was an error.
